question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "flooded."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The sentence containing the blank represents a situation in which the subject enters the bathroom and finds it filled with the water.
 
 
• Now, **among the given options, the word "flooded" can be used as it is correct when we speak about water.**
